rationale: Junior office role combining estimating and contract administration for a Victorian civil and commercial landscape contractor: reviewing construction drawings and tender documents, quantity take-offs, requests for pricing and keeping project records.

The advert asks for numeracy, Excel, reading drawings or willingness to learn, and only rates landscaping, civil or estimating experience as highly regarded, so nothing mandatory is unmet; Marc's coursework covered cost estimates and bills of quantities and his Philippines site work included reviewing drawings, tracking procurement and keeping material records.
Laverton North is in Melbourne's west, close to Melton; scored 66 rather than higher because the role is estimating and administration rather than civil design or site work.
caution: Estimating experience is coursework only (cost estimates and bills of quantities), not a paid estimating role, and Marc has not used estimating software. Landscape focus is new to him.
gaps: No paid estimating or contract administration experience; estimating is Advanced Diploma coursework
apply_instructions: Apply through SEEK with resume and a short introduction (advert wording).
title: Junior Estimator/Contract Administrator
screening_questions: Which of the following statements best describes your right to work in Australia?
What's your expected annual base salary?
How much notice are you required to give your current employer?
